name: empty
title: Empty
description: What shows where a list has nothing in it yet: a dashed hairline with square corners, a Lucide icon in a #141414 tile, an Agencidev Sans title, one muted line and the actions that fill it.
use_for: A new project, a search with no results, a list before the first item.
never: Illustrations or the no-signal static inside it
An empty state with no way forward
source: shadcn's empty, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.

examples.name: Project
examples.label: An empty project
examples.content:
<!-- A new project with nothing in it yet, and the way to fill it. -->
<agd-empty class="max-w-160" heading="No screens yet." description="Start from a flow in the design system, or bring in what the team already has.">
  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-bookmark" slot="icon"><path d="m19 21-7-4-7 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16z"></path></svg>
  <agd-button><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-search" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path></svg>Start a flow</agd-button>
  <agd-button variant="secondary">Import from Figma</agd-button>
</agd-empty>
